role_title: Senior Product Manager (Sage Intacct Budgeting & Planning)
workplace_mode: Hybrid (3 days per week in office)

core_pm_craft_and_execution.rationale: Strong evidence of owning product roadmaps, translating customer and workflow research into requirements, defining feature success metrics, and coordinating cross-functional launches (lines 64-82, 227-238).

domain_problem_space_alignment.rationale: Strong alignment on enterprise business operations, IT operations, finance stakeholder alignment, internal P&L/forecasting/budgeting ownership, and enterprise asset/procurement systems at Lowe's India (lines 65-71, 91-99, 459-462, 489-494). Adjacent (not direct) on building commercial external FP&A / multi-dimensional accounting software.

technical_platform_ai_depth.rationale: Direct match on B.Tech CS degree, agile cloud/SaaS product delivery, and practical experience scoping and launching AI-driven workflow improvements (Lowe's AI-driven procurement/catalog platform, lines 96-99).

seniority_and_scope_match.rationale: Directly matches Senior Product Manager level; ~11 years total experience with ~6 years in formal PM titles is slightly below the stated '7+ years in B2B product management' if strictly counting B2B-only PM titles, though total product + consulting + enterprise tenure exceeds 10 years.

measurable_impact_and_commercial_relevan.rationale: Strong enterprise and commercial impact: $2M annual cost savings from unified asset lifecycle platform, ~$10M annual revenue protection, 20% cycle time reduction, and 35% conversion improvement.

stakeholder_and_leadership_complexity.rationale: Exceptional alignment with the JD's requirement to collaborate across Business Operations, IT Operations, Finance, Product Marketing, Sales, and international teams (lines 65-71, 367, 483-494).

location_work_mode_practical_constraints.rationale: Bangalore hybrid (3 days/week in office) matches candidate's location.

six_dimension_summary.role_scope: Senior Product Manager owning the roadmap, business workflow research, beta programs, and cross-functional business/IT operations enhancements for Sage Intacct Budgeting & Planning.
six_dimension_summary.seniority_alignment: Strong alignment with Senior Product Manager title and cross-organizational scope; slight stretch on 7+ years strictly B2B PM tenure (~6 years formal PM across B2C/EdTech and B2B Enterprise within ~11 years total career).
six_dimension_summary.product_discipline: B2B SaaS / Enterprise Financial & Business Operations Product Management — strong match with candidate's enterprise workflow, finance-partnered platforms, and GTM background.
six_dimension_summary.domain_relevance: Direct experience owning internal P&L, forecasting, budgeting, headcount planning, and finance-partnered asset lifecycle platforms ($2M savings); adjacent to commercial FP&A accounting software.
six_dimension_summary.leadership_expectations: Cross-company coordination across Business Ops, IT Ops, Product Marketing, Support, and Sales — directly evidenced across Lowe's India and Hype.
six_dimension_summary.evidence_strength: High direct/adjacent coverage across required skills; nice-to-have FP&A software domain is bridged via hands-on financial/budgeting governance and IIM Bangalore EGMP.

key_strengths: Spearheaded a unified enterprise asset lifecycle platform in partnership with Finance and Operations stakeholders at Lowe's India, delivering ~$2M in annual cost savings (lines 91-95).
Owned P&L responsibilities, forecasting, budgeting, investment prioritization, and headcount planning across strategic product and operational initiatives (lines 458-462, 489-494).

Designed and launched an AI-driven procurement and catalog system reducing operational cycle times by 20%, alongside collaborating across Business Ops, IT Ops, and Marketing teams (lines 65-71, 96-99).
positioning_angle: Position as an Enterprise SaaS & Financial Operations Senior Product Manager who partners deeply with Finance, Business Operations, IT Operations, and Product Marketing to streamline enterprise provisioning, asset lifecycle ($2M savings), and AI-driven procurement workflows (20% cycle time reduction). Bridge hands-on P&L, forecasting, and budgeting governance (plus IIM Bangalore executive management training) to Sage Intacct Budgeting & Planning.
red_flags_and_gaps: No prior experience building a commercial multi-dimensional FP&A or accounting software product (listed as 'Nice to Have' in the JD).
Formal PM title tenure is ~6 years across EdTech and Enterprise (within ~11 years total career), slightly short of 7+ years exclusively in B2B PM.
Explicit beta program administration is adjacent to prototyping and iterative product launch management (12 cross-product prototypes at Byju's).
